value.rationale: The mean solid angle of the geodesic convex hull of three independent fixed-latitude points is a natural geometric statistic with direct finite-sampling interpretation; the previously available full-sphere expectation does not vary with cap geometry. The exact non-elementary dilogarithm law provides strict one-parameter inversion, two sharp endpoint expansions, and a nontrivial near-equatorial limit without claiming a paper-sized or high-dimensional generalization.
